title: Sahidic Old Testament (CoptOT)
rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Coptic SCRIPTORIUM / CoptOT, KELLIA; text from CrossWire’s CoptOT). Share alike.
method: Candidate names, not names. For each Strong's lemma the KJV concordance gives the verses it is tagged in; every word in those same verses of Sahidic Old Testament (CoptOT) is scored by count × lift over its frequency in that Bible, forms sharing 4+ consecutive characters counted as one word, and a candidate is kept only where it beats the runner-up by 2×. This measures how one translation uses a word. It is not a translation, not a definition, and not published to any reader until a person confirms it.
morphology: Coptic writes its articles and prepositions onto the front of the word, so forms are grouped from four shared characters.
